cnot.scope: Retained uniform circuit-level depolarizing-noise Stim/PyMatching samples. Marginal observable errors from joint mistake masks. Base circuit manifest identifies compiler 8f5d98a48b90f044ce3e423469f55bc265d9ddeb at d=3,5,7; higher-distance rows retain their own circuit hashes in the raw statistics. Crossings use the outermost sampled distances, with a sampled-grid bracket, not a fitted uncertainty interval. Correlation surface labels follow the retained source generators' external support, with C on the left temporal wire and T on the right.

t_source.scope: Physical cultivated T sources, equal X/Z GAP cuts, ordinary matching; d=5,7,9,11 and p=.0001,.0002,.0005,.001,.002. Accepted infidelity includes fractional Pauli contributions. Null estimates indicate no accepted samples and are omitted from the log plot.
t_source.uncertainty: Pointwise nominal 95% moment intervals; no simultaneous coverage claim.

ccz.uncertainty: Pointwise nominal 95% delta-method intervals; shared measured-floor covariance retained for residuals. Source reference treated as exact. Fit bands include sampling overdispersion but exclude model bias. No simultaneous-coverage claim.
ccz.scope: Full unpinned path mixture only, physical error probability 0.001, d=9,11,13,15. No diagonal-only observations or distance extrapolation beyond d=15.

t_gate.uncertainty: Nominal 95% half-widths. Six-state mean uses equal weights and independent input-state variances; Choi uses independent shots.
